## Core Thesis

Management is about compliance. Leadership is about courage.
When organizations stall, it is rarely a strategy problem. It is almost always an architecture problem. Consensus diffuses authority across endless decks. Decisive mandate demands sovereign clarity. We re-architect the operating system in 90 days so leadership operates with total velocity — without endless consensus committees, bureaucratic approval bottlenecks, and key-person operational drag.
